For iPhone, iPad and Mac

Edit the calendars you subscribe to.

Work shifts, school, sports and holidays arrive read-only and slightly wrong. Calendar Corrector fixes them once and keeps a clean, auto-updating copy in your own calendar.

Coming soon to the App StoreEmail me at launch
  • First calendar free
  • No account
  • Originals never changed
  • 44 languages

Fix it once. Every future event follows.

Subscribed calendars can’t be edited, so mistakes repeat every week. Calendar Corrector learns your fixes and applies them as new events arrive.

Work shifts

Overnight shifts on the right day

Scheduling apps often publish a closing shift as ending at 6 AM. Calendar Corrector spots the pattern, ends them when you really finish, and keeps true late shifts as they are.

  • Your job name first in every title, so two jobs never blur together
  • Your own name removed from every event
  • Works with 7shifts, Deputy, When I Work, Homebase, Google Calendar links and more

School, teams and holidays

Hide what isn’t yours

Keep your child’s grade and the school-wide days off. Keep your team’s games, start them 30 minutes early and colour the away games. Keep only the holidays where you live, in your language.

The details, handled

Never goes blank

If a feed breaks or suddenly empties, you keep the last good version and get a warning.

Alerts and colours

Add alerts, birthday reminders and colours to any kind of event.

Busy, not free

Mark all-day events as busy so nobody books over your days off.

Private

No account and no server. Calendar links stay in your device’s keychain.

Questions

Does it change my original calendar?

No. Your original subscription keeps syncing untouched. Calendar Corrector writes a corrected copy into a calendar it creates, and you hide the original in the Calendar app.

Which calendars work?

Any calendar already on your device, or any calendar link (.ics or webcal) from a scheduling app, school, team or Google Calendar.

Is there an Android version?

An Android version is in development. Email us to hear when it’s ready.

When will it be on the App Store?

Very soon. Email us and we’ll tell you on launch day.
